evidence_items.explanation: Responses were collected from late February through late March. The citation-support shortcomings establish an existing search problem, but do not establish that a near-term solution lacked credible grounds.

This research, initially released in 2022, supplies a concrete method and reports improved attribution. Its remaining reasoning and retrieval limitations prevent treating that progress as a demonstrated solution to open-ended search hallucinations.
